newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Telefonica de Argentina to get $150 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Telefonica de Argentina to get $150 mln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Dec 17 (LPC) - Chase Manhattan Corp and Dresdner Bank AG are in the Latin syndicated loan market with a $150 million loan that will refinance debt of Telefonica de Argentina, banking sources said.
The deal, which is the latest example of a Latin borrower refinancing credit at lower pricing, takes out a $150 million loan from February, a banker said.
Pricing on the new deal is 100 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) in year one, stepping up to 131.25 basis points over LIBOR in year two, the banker added.
The deal also has a provision that, if a bank holds the credit in Argentina, the bank will receive additional compensation totaling roughly 25 basis points, bankers said.
Telefonica is willing to pay this fee because any funds held onshore will be exempt from the Argentine withholding tax on foreign loans, bankers added.
The existing deal is priced at 250 basis points over LIBOR initially, and will step up to 287.5 basis points over LIBOR in February, when the new deal will take effect, a banker said.
